title: An Ancient Solution to Modern Problems

sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: On the surface, people around the world lead very different lives.
sentences.zh: 从表面上看，世界各地的人们过着截然不同的生活。

sentences.en: Some live in bustling cities, others in tiny villages.
sentences.zh: 有些人住在繁华的城市，有些人住在偏远的小村庄。

sentences.en: Some are part of vast intergenerational households.
sentences.zh: 有些人生活在庞大的多代同堂家庭中。
而另一些人则独自生活。

sentences.en: People in different countries follow a bewildering range of religious traditions,
sentences.zh: 不同国家的人们遵循着令人眼花缭乱的宗教传统，

sentences.en: but atheism is also on the rise in many places.
sentences.zh: 但在许多地方，无神论也在兴起。

sentences.en: When anthropologists look beneath the surface, however,
sentences.zh: 然而，当人类学家深入探究表面之下时，

sentences.en: they often find that humans around the world are very similar.
sentences.zh: 他们往往发现世界各地的人类其实非常相似。

sentences.en: They invoke supernatural forces when it looks like their sports teams might lose.
sentences.zh: 当他们支持的运动队看起来要输掉比赛时，他们会祈求超自然力量的帮助。

sentences.en: They take part in annual festivals that demand time, effort, and money.
sentences.zh: 他们参加需要投入时间、精力和金钱的年度节日。

sentences.en: They mark important moments, such as marriages, births, and deaths,
sentences.zh: 他们用精心编排的仪式来标记重要的时刻，

sentences.en: These festivals, rites, and scripts are so much a part of all our lives
sentences.zh: 这些节日、仪式和脚本在我们的生活中占据了如此重要的部分，

sentences.en: that few of us stop to ask why we perform them.
sentences.zh: 以至于很少有人停下来问问自己为什么要执行它们。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, the deep history and powerful psychology of rituals.
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》节目，我们将探讨仪式的深层历史和强大的心理学机制。

sentences.en: Anthropologist Demetrius Zigalatas works at the University of Connecticut.
sentences.zh: 人类学家德米特里·齐加拉塔斯在康涅狄格大学工作。

sentences.en: His research has taken him across the planet.
sentences.zh: 他的研究足迹遍布全球。

sentences.en: In his travels, Demetrius has found common cultural practices
sentences.zh: 在旅行中，德米特里发现了一些共同的文化习俗，

sentences.en: among people living in far-flung places.
sentences.zh: 存在于生活在遥远地方的人们之间。

sentences.en: Many of these practices involve dangerous, difficult, or expensive rituals.
sentences.zh: 其中许多习俗涉及危险、困难或昂贵的仪式。

sentences.en: The rituals themselves are often dramatic.
sentences.zh: 这些仪式本身往往非常戏剧化。

sentences.en: They are also regularly incomprehensible to outsiders.
sentences.zh: 对于局外人来说，它们也常常令人费解。

sentences.en: But when you peer beneath the surface,
sentences.zh: 但当你深入表面之下观察时，

sentences.en: rituals actually reveal a great deal about the human mind
sentences.zh: 仪式实际上揭示了人类思维的许多奥秘，

sentences.en: and the psychological features that people around the world have in common.
sentences.zh: 以及世界各地人们所共有的心理特征。

sentences.en: Demetrius Zigalatas, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 德米特里·齐加拉塔斯，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。
